name: Unassigned board
description:
1. Added a virtual **"Unassigned"** board (`NO_BOARD_ID`) in `src/store/kanban.js` grouping every chat with no board, kept read-only and never persisted.
2. Added virtual **"Unassigned" columns** (`NO_COLUMN_ID` / `NO_STATUS_ID`) for kanban chats without a `column` and sprint tasks without a matching `status`, so cards can be dragged in/out to clear or set the field.
3. Fixed the board not appearing in the list and the sprint column never rendering by making `virtualBoards` and `sprintColumns` always expose them (previously gated on existing content).
4. Fixed sprint tasks with an **invalid** status (no column groups it) being invisible: `sprintColumns` now collects the board's real statuses and routes everything unplaceable into the virtual column, with a warning chip showing the raw value in `SprintBoardColumn.vue`.
5. Guardrails throughout: virtual columns/board are skipped by `syncColumnOrder`, `syncSprintColumnOrder`, `newSprintTask` and the canvas (no create/edit/reorder/persist), and `SprintBoardCanvas.vue` uses column `value` instead of `title` for drag payloads.

messages.content:

And virtual columns for boards and sprints for chat column/status not defined so user can drag to the right column.

2. **Discovery:** The kanban store already had a `NO_BOARD_ID` virtual-board skeleton, but undefined `column`/`status` values fell into "To Do" and the `--none--` placeholder was being persisted as a real column on drag.
3. **`src/store/kanban.js`:** Renamed the virtual board to `Unassigned`, added `NO_STATUS_ID`, made `buildViewColumns`/`sprintColumns` emit `virtual: true` columns (only while they hold tasks), excluded virtuals from `syncColumnOrder`/`syncSprintColumnOrder`, and made `moveTask`/`moveSprintStatus` clear the field when dropped in.
4. **Components:** `SprintBoardColumn.vue` now drags by column `value` (not display `title`) and renders virtual columns with dashed triage styling; `SprintBoardCanvas.vue` disables create/edit/reorder on virtual columns and emits `value` on task reorder.
5. **Result:** Placeholders are never persisted onto chats, real boards look unchanged when fully classified, and a drag out of "Unassigned" writes the field while dropping back in clears it.

1. **Goal:** add a virtual **Unassigned** board (board-less chats) plus virtual **Unassigned** columns on kanban/sprint boards for chats with no `column`/`status`, usable as drag & drop targets.
2. **First implementation** (`store/kanban.js`, `SprintBoardColumn.vue`, `SprintBoardCanvas.vue`): `NO_BOARD_ID`/`NO_COLUMN_ID`/`NO_STATUS_ID` placeholders, `value` vs `title` separation so the label is never written onto a chat, virtual columns skipped by `syncColumnOrder`/`syncSprintColumnOrder`, and `moveTask`/`moveSprintStatus` clearing the field when a card is dropped back in.
3. **Bug reported:** the Unassigned board was missing from the board list and the Unassigned column never showed on sprint boards.
4. **Root cause:** both entities were gated on having content — `virtualBoards` returned `[]` unless `noBoardChats.length`, and `sprintColumns` only pushed the virtual column `if (unclassified.length)`, which is normally empty since new sprint tasks get `status: 'todo'`.
5. **Fix (store only):** `virtualBoards` always exposes the board and `sprintColumns` always appends the virtual column last, both still `virtual: true` so they are never persisted, editable, reorderable or creation targets; the board view stays read-only for virtual boards.

1. Added a virtual **"Unassigned"** board (`NO_BOARD_ID`) in `src/store/kanban.js` grouping every chat with no board, kept read-only and never persisted.
2. Added virtual **"Unassigned" columns** (`NO_COLUMN_ID` / `NO_STATUS_ID`) for kanban chats without a `column` and sprint tasks without a matching `status`, so cards can be dragged in/out to clear or set the field.
3. Fixed the board not appearing in the list and the sprint column never rendering by making `virtualBoards` and `sprintColumns` always expose them (previously gated on existing content).
4. Fixed sprint tasks with an **invalid** status (no column groups it) being invisible: `sprintColumns` now collects the board's real statuses and routes everything unplaceable into the virtual column, with a warning chip showing the raw value in `SprintBoardColumn.vue`.
5. Guardrails throughout: virtual columns/board are skipped by `syncColumnOrder`, `syncSprintColumnOrder`, `newSprintTask` and the canvas (no create/edit/reorder/persist), and `SprintBoardCanvas.vue` uses column `value` instead of `title` for drag payloads.
